summary: Positive readiness-gated diagnostic: after both expected node-role endpoints reported zookeeper=on for the embedded host and zookeeper=off for the second node, both CLI variants stopped in the expected order, completed in under five seconds, and emitted no force-kill marker. This supports the startup-race hypothesis but does not establish a general shutdown guarantee.

details: The temporary focused test waited for both expected node-role endpoint states before invoking solr stop --all; the original process-order shim and SOLR_STOP_WAIT=30 no-force-kill assertion were retained.
